laws.rule: Natural History Museum, Bulawayo: outside research workers may obtain permission from the Regional Director or Senior Librarian for the specialist library. The page says it is not a public library and encourages groups to arrange educational visits well in advance. This is not a requirement for every ordinary museum visitor to obtain research approval.
